rv.q: If you're a fan of professional wrestling, 'Lucha Teotl' is a no brainer. Ditto if you want a night out that's equal parts high camp, bruising physicality and cultural celebration.
This show is truly a must-see experience.
No matter their age or interest in sports, audiences will find themselves inexplicably drawn into this heroic story and the melodramatics of the play.
These folks are good! In fact, not good, GREAT!
I genuinely cannot remember the last time I enjoyed myself at a play as much as I did here.
